AiEvaluationDefinition.description: Bulk test suite for the Rep Support agent — knowledge questions route to answer_rep_questions/search_knowledge; bug/draft/escalate utterances route to the right sub-agents.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: Rep_Support_Tests

expectation.expectedValue: The agent explains how a customer can meet a maintenance/FM call from an internal Knowledge article, cites the article, and ends with a Confidence line. It does not fabricate.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: How can a customer meet an FM call?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent explains the wire funding/availability process from an internal article, with a citation and a Confidence line.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: How does a customer fund their account by wire, and when are the funds available?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent explains where a customer finds their 1099 tax documents from an internal article, cited, ending with a Confidence line.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Where does a customer find their 1099 tax documents?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent explains the account-access / 2FA recovery steps from an internal article, cited, ending with a Confidence line.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: A customer is locked out of their account and can't get past two-factor authentication. What do they do?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent explains what happens to an in-the-money option at expiration (assignment/exercise) from an internal article, cited, ending with a Confidence line.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What happens to an in-the-money option at expiration?

expectation.expectedValue: The agent recognizes a defect report, gathers a summary/description, and files a Jira bug, returning the issue key.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: File a bug — the Positions page throws an error every time I filter by futures.

expectation.expectedValue: The agent recognizes a request to document new content, proposes a title/summary, and drafts a knowledge article (draft only, human-reviewed).
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Can you document this for the team? When a customer's ACAT is stuck in review, we tell them to contact the delivering firm to confirm the transfer instructions.

expectation.expectedValue: The agent recognizes the request for a human and escalates to a team lead with context, and does not try to answer from Knowledge.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: I'm stuck on this and I need to talk to a team lead about the account.
